name: Chromaggus
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/blackwing-lair/chromaggus.md. Era 40-man: 1,832,050 HP, no timer enrage, a hard enrage below 20% HP (permanent +50% attack speed, +219-282 damage). Two phases: to 20% in 300 s and the enrage 60 s to the end (research: 5-7 minutes; this is the short end). Breaths: two of the five are fixed per instance lockout (Warcraft Wiki, cmangos); Incinerate and Time Lapse are the pair scripted here (this lockout's choice; a real raid may get Corrosive Acid, Frost Burn or Ignite Flesh instead, and those are not scripted). Timers follow cmangos/BigWigs: breath A at 30 s then every 60 s, breath B at 60 s then every 60 s, so one breath every 30 s (logs: 27-37 s, 57-68 s, 61.5 s each). Breaths hit everyone in his line of sight in the room (Warcraft Wiki, Wowhead, cmangos), so they are room-wide `aoe`s with `safeSpots`: two walls at y=4 and a hide spot behind each (`hideSpotW` and `hideSpotE`, radius 3, checked by computation to be on the floor, hidden from the boss spot and within 40 yards of the tank, so healers really can heal the main tank from cover, as the guides describe). Incinerate 3900 Fire (real 3675-4275), Time Lapse 0 damage. The real cast is 2 s; the bar here is 5 s (`offBoss`), standing for the boss-mod warning, the same device Broodlord's Blast Wave uses, because melee need about 3.5 s to reach cover from his back. Time Lapse's `-50% max health` cannot be expressed. The `breath` cone stays only so the tank is scored on his facing. Time Lapse: `follow` applies a `debuff` that stuns the player for 8 s (spell data 8 s on Wowhead Classic and classicdb; older guides say 6 s) and a `targetSwitch` for the threat drop (Warcraft Wiki: removed only in 2.0.1, warlock notes "wipes threat"). The real plan has the off-tanks and some healers leave line of sight while everyone else takes it so the off-tank holds him (Wowhead, Warcraft Wiki); here the tank role stands for that off-tank: it is not stunned and must Taunt him the moment the threat drop lands. The healer seat hides at the same spots (`safeRoles: healer`) and keeps the raid alive while it is stunned; melee and ranged take the stun, which is correct for them. Brood Afflictions (Warcraft Wiki, classicdb, Warcraft Tavern, cmangos ~7 s cadence, open question: unknown whether one cast hits one player or several; here one player per cast): Red Disease 50 Fire every 3 s, Green Poison 250 Nature every 5 s and -50% healing, Blue Magic (casting speed and mana effects not expressible), Black Curse +100% Fire taken (`damageTakenMult` 1.5 on the player here, 1.3 on a tank, because the engine multiplier applies to all damage, not only Fire), Bronze undispellable, 4 s stun (real: every ~5 s roll; item Hourglass Sand only). Debuff durations are 15 s (real 10 minutes) because the ghost raid does not dispel debuffs on itself and a 10-minute debuff would pile up unrealistically; a tank-targeted Black Curse stands for the tank-first decurse priority. `playerChance` 0.25 instead of the fair 1/40. The healer's Dispel carries all four dispellable types; Bronze has no button (Hourglass Sand is an item, not modelled). Chromatic Mutation at 5 afflictions cannot be expressed. Frenzy: first 12.5-22.5 s then every 10-18 s (open question; 16 s used, close to cmangos 15 s and DBM 16.1-17.8 s), 8 s, +150% attack speed, hunter Tranquilizing Shot only. Modelled as an `enrage` `debuff` on the tank with `damageTakenMult` 1.3 for 4 s, short because in the other seats the ghost hunters remove it; the `ranged` seat carries Tranquilizing Shot (`roles.ranged.dispels: ['enrage']`) and is scored on it (press cue and `debuffSeconds`; healers cannot remove it). Elemental Shield and the school-vulnerability rotation (which school to attack with) cannot be expressed; there are no damage schools. Damage is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike: melee 650 per 2 s, Incinerate 3900, Frenzy x1.3 and the 20% enrage x1.5 melee (`boss.enrageMultiplier`); placeholders. Passive healing is 1250 HP/s on a player tank, 1050 on the ghost without a healer player, 200 with one. Aggro pulls every ~45 s stand in for DPS on his vulnerable school (12x damage means 12x threat), which the engine cannot express otherwise. Engine gaps: cover stops only the damage to you and attacks have no line of sight, so a ranged player in cover can keep attacking (real casters step into sight to cast); no school vulnerability, no Chromatic Mutation, no resources (Blue), no Hourglass Sand, no Tranq cooldown, no Elemental Shield. Fidelity correction: normal encounter schedules no longer inject artificial DPS aggro pulls; threat changes through combat and actual encounter mechanics. Dedicated aggro drills retain their explicit stress events.

labels.text: Hide wall: step behind for breaths

tankSpot.label: Tank: he stands here all fight, facing away from the raid

rangedSpot.label: Ranged: behind him, one step from the wall

hideSpotW.label: Behind the wall: out of his sight

hideSpotE.label: Behind the wall: out of his sight

healerSpot.label: Healers: at the wall, in reach of the tank

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Plant him with his back to the raid and never move him. Eat every breath. In this rehearsal you are the tank who dodges Time Lapse: the moment it lands, Taunt him to you. In the real raid the main tank is stunned too; you are playing the off-tank who stays out of sight. Below 20% he enrages: everything hits harder and the raid burns.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stack behind him and step around the wall for every breath except Time Lapse, which you take in the open. Stay behind him; only the tank belongs in front.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stay at the wall, step in to cast, step behind it for every breath except Time Lapse. Tranq every Frenzy the moment it lands; only Hunters can remove it. Only cast the school he is vulnerable to. Keep your threat under the tank.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Dispel the Afflictions: Blue on healers and hunters first, then Green on tanks, then Black before a Fire breath, then Red. Keep the tank up through breaths and every Frenzy; a Frenzy that gets through is 2.5x swings, and only Hunters can shoot it off. Hide behind the wall for every breath, Time Lapse included: you can reach the tank from cover and you heal the raid through the stun.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment he turns on the raid, never while he is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel / Tranq
dispel.tip: Healers: removes the oldest Affliction you can cleanse, one button standing in for four classes. Ranged: this is Tranquilizing Shot and only his Frenzy can be shot off.

incinerate.label: Incinerate
incinerate.tip: A 2 s cast (the bar here is the boss-mod warning) and 3700 to 4300 Fire to everyone in his line of sight, whole room. Get behind a wall before it lands; the tank eats it.

timeLapse.label: Time Lapse
timeLapse.tip: A 2 s cast (the bar here is the boss-mod warning) that stuns everyone he can see for 8 seconds and drops their threat. Off-tanks and some healers leave his sight; everyone else takes it so the off-tank has aggro alone. Melee and ranged take this one in the open.

timeLapseTurn.label: Time Lapse: threat drop
timeLapseTurn.toast: Time Lapse dropped the threat table. Get him back as soon as you can move.
timeLapseTurn.tip: Everybody's threat has been slashed. Take him back the moment you can act.

broodRed.label: Brood Affliction: Red
broodRed.tip: Disease: 50 Fire every 3 s, and if the player dies with it Chromaggus heals. Priests and Paladins cure it.

broodGreen.label: Brood Affliction: Green
broodGreen.tip: Poison: 250 Nature every 5 s and healing taken halved. Druids and Paladins cure it; on a tank it comes off first.

broodBlue.label: Brood Affliction: Blue
broodBlue.tip: Magic: burns mana and halves casting speed. Priests and Paladins dispel it, healers and hunters first.

broodBlack.label: Brood Affliction: Black
broodBlack.tip: Curse: Fire damage taken doubled. Mages and Druids decurse it, always before a Fire breath.

broodBlackTank.label: Brood Affliction: Black (tank)
broodBlackTank.tip: A Curse on the tank before a Fire breath is the most dangerous one of all. Mages and Druids decurse the tank first.

broodBronze.label: Brood Affliction: Bronze
broodBronze.tip: No dispel: periodically stuns for 4 seconds. Only Hourglass Sand (an item) removes it, and Restorative Potions or Ice Block clear the lot.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.tip: He goes into a killing frenzy every 10 to 18 seconds: +150% attack speed for 8 seconds. Hunters Tranquilizing Shot it off in a fixed order.

enrage.label: Enrage
enrage.toast: Chromaggus enrages at 20%! Everything hits harder.
enrage.tip: Below 20% he is permanently enraged: +50% attack speed, +219-282 damage. Execute range and burn.

aggroPull.label: Aggro pull
aggroPull.tip: A DPS on his vulnerable school does 12x damage and 12x threat. It happens fast.

expectations.label: Plant him and never move him
expectations.tip: Walk him to the tank spot with his back to the raid and stop. The whole raid plans around a wall two steps away; if you drag him, it collapses.

expectations.label: Take him back after Time Lapse
expectations.tip: Time Lapse slashes everyone's threat. In this rehearsal you are the tank who dodged it, so you Taunt the instant he turns.

expectations.label: Take him back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: A DPS on his vulnerable school gets 12x threat. Taunt the moment he turns.

expectations.label: He faces away from the raid, always
expectations.tip: Every breath but Time Lapse hits everyone he can see. His head stays away from the raid.

expectations.label: Cure Brood Affliction: Red
expectations.tip: Disease. If someone dies with it he heals. Priests and Paladins cure it.

expectations.label: Cure Brood Affliction: Green
expectations.tip: Poison and half healing. Get it off the tanks first.

expectations.label: Dispel Brood Affliction: Blue
expectations.tip: Magic. It starves healers and hunters of mana. Healers and hunters first.

expectations.label: Decurse Brood Affliction: Black
expectations.tip: Curse: Fire damage doubled. On the tank before a Fire breath it can kill.

expectations.label: Tranq the Frenzy off
expectations.tip: Tranquilizing Shot the moment he frenzies. If it stays up, the tank takes 2.5x swings for 8 seconds.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stop in the red band
expectations.tip: A DPS on his vulnerable school is at 12x threat. The bar goes red fast.

expectations.label: Get behind a wall for every breath
expectations.tip: Breaths hit everyone in his line of sight, the whole room. Get behind a hide wall before it lands. Only the tank eats them; melee and ranged take Time Lapse in the open.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Melee, breaths, Frenzy bursts and Afflictions on the tank. Keep them above 60 percent going into every breath and every Frenzy.

expectations.label: Take him back after Time Lapse
expectations.tip: He is enraged and the threat table was just slashed. Taunt him the moment he turns.

expectations.label: Cure Brood Affliction: Red
expectations.tip: Disease. Still ticking.

expectations.label: Cure Brood Affliction: Green
expectations.tip: Half healing on the tank in the enrage window is how the tank dies. Get it off.

expectations.label: Dispel Brood Affliction: Blue
expectations.tip: Healers and hunters first.

expectations.label: Tranq the Frenzy off
expectations.tip: A Frenzy on top of the enrage is a dead tank. Tranq it the moment it lands.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Get behind a wall for every breath
expectations.tip: Still the whole room, even at the end.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: From 20% he hits 50% faster. Nothing here is optional: heal the tank and keep the Frenzy off.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

outOfRange.label: Seconds out of range
outOfRange.tip: Melee walk behind a wall for every Incinerate and straight back. Being out of range at any other time is wasted time.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in fire
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the fire before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a removable debuff up
debuffSeconds.tip: Healers: cleanse the moment it lands. Ranged: Tranq the Frenzy the moment it lands.

cues.notes: Press notes: Taunt when he turns; Tranq and dispel Afflictions the moment they land; Heal when the tank is low.

list.label: Taunt him back
list.tip: Time Lapse dropped the threat table, or a DPS on his vulnerable school overtook you. Taunt him now.

list.label: Dispel the Affliction
list.tip: Dispel it the moment it lands: Blue on healers and hunters, Green on tanks, Black before a Fire breath.

list.label: Dispel the Affliction
list.tip: Dispel it the moment it lands: Blue on healers and hunters, Green on tanks, Black before a Fire breath.

list.label: Dispel the Affliction
list.tip: Dispel it the moment it lands: Blue on healers and hunters, Green on tanks, Black before a Fire breath.

list.label: Dispel the Affliction
list.tip: Dispel it the moment it lands: Blue on healers and hunters, Green on tanks, Black before a Fire breath.

list.label: Dispel the Affliction
list.tip: Dispel it the moment it lands: Blue on healers and hunters, Green on tanks, Black before a Fire breath.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a breath coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Tranq the Frenzy
drills.description: Frenzy every 8 s: Tranq it off inside 2 seconds, and step behind the wall for the breaths.

drills.name: Time Lapse and aggro
drills.description: Already on him. Time Lapse every 22 s: you are stunned, then take him back. Aggro pulls on top.

drills.name: Vulnerable-school threat
drills.description: Attack on every global, stop in the red band: a DPS on his vulnerable school outruns the tank fast. Time Lapse every 22 s wipes the table.

drills.name: Afflictions and breaths
drills.description: An Affliction every 5 s: cleanse everything you can the moment it lands, tank first. Hunters take the Frenzy; you heal through it and get behind the wall for the breaths.

limitations: Time Lapse does not correctly stun and halve the tank’s health. Breath selection and affliction combinations are scripted.
